answer: Agents commit to 1,000 unique computational tasks as the scarce resource for work, where honest nodes pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier maps each lotus-indexed task to a specific state. If a trellis-patterned memory overlap appears across parallel outputs, it burns the identity and forfeits all deposits. Every pigment-coded log transition must be unique to pass audit; this assumes distinct execution paths cannot be pooled.
